fields.label: Address
fields.help: The IP address of the dongle - or of the inverter's LAN port, or the adapter - as your router lists it. Just the address: no http://, no port.
fields.patternMessage: Just the IP address or host name - no http://, no port, no path.

fields.label: Modbus port
fields.help: 502, unless an adapter was set to another.

fields.label: Modbus unit ID
fields.help: 1 for a Pocket WiFi 3.0. On the inverter's own LAN port or an adapter, the Modbus address set in the inverter's menu - 1 unless it was changed; some come set to 4.

fields.label: Modbus framing
fields.help: Leave on Modbus TCP. RTU over TCP is only for an RS485 adapter in transparent mode.
